execution_tier.first_party_executable: Productized hero workflow surfaced through the canonical bio-agent session/run control plane.
execution_tier.bridge_executable: Runnable capability exposed through discovered tool/skill bridges, but not yet packaged as a first-party hero lane.
execution_tier.reference_only: Grounded workflow or knowledge surface kept for planning/reference honesty rather than direct first-party execution claims.

runtime_mode.session-hero-runner: Thin adapter over canonical session/run truth.
runtime_mode.local-cli: Depends on a locally available tool bridge.
runtime_mode.prompt-bridge: Skill/prompt surface without a verified local executable contract.
runtime_mode.planning-reference: Registry/documentation-only capability used for planning and comparison.

verification_level.benchmark_contract: Backed by benchmark contract checks and smoke coverage.
verification_level.machine_detected: Local executable or command bridge detected on this machine.
verification_level.declared_only: Declared by metadata but not currently verified as locally available.

reproducibility_level.automatic_session_bundle: Hero runner emits a reproducibility bundle automatically.
reproducibility_level.manual_bridge: Reproducibility depends on operator-managed bridge/tool usage.
reproducibility_level.not_packaged: No first-party reproducibility bundle is promised yet.
